_meta.description: Category → website inspiration profile. Reference URLs are NOT scraped; they are listed so humans reviewing can verify the aesthetic direction. AI receives only the palette, layouts, tone, must_include, and avoid fields — never the URLs — to stay legally clean.

must_include: clear H1 stating what the business does and where
avoid: stock-photo heroes with no local context
lorem ipsum or placeholder copy in shipped output
interaction_kit: sticky top nav that shrinks after 80px scroll
scroll-reveal fade+slide-up on every major section (IntersectionObserver, 400ms ease-out)
hover lift (translateY -2px + deeper shadow) on cards and primary buttons
smooth scroll on anchor links

realtor.tone: warm, trustworthy, locally rooted; premium without feeling corporate
must_include: certifications and designations (e.g. SRES, CSA, CAPS)
recent sales or client story if available
avoid: generic drone shots of suburbs unrelated to agent's market
MLS IDX widgets in the hero
interaction_kit: hero with scroll-linked parallax on the background image (translate 0.2x scroll)
agent portrait scale 1.03 on hover inside a fixed frame
staggered fade-in on agent cards (120ms per card)
accent-colored underline reveal on agent contact links

plumber.tone: direct, confidence-inspiring, emergency-ready; skilled tradesperson — not polished marketing fluff
must_include: licensed and bonded statement with license number
core services list (drain, water heater, sewer, leak, etc.)
service area by city or zip
avoid: vague 'plumbing services' headlines without a real offer
hiding the phone number below the fold
interaction_kit: sticky '24/7 Call Now' bar pinned to the bottom on mobile, top-right on desktop
subtle pulse on the emergency CTA (box-shadow scale, 2.5s loop)
hover fill on service cards: border goes accent, card lifts 3px
scroll-reveal stagger on service grid

landscaper.tone: grounded, craft-oriented, visual-first; showcase the work, not the sales pitch
must_include: hero image of actual completed project (not stock)
service list (design, install, maintenance, hardscape, irrigation)
seasonal scheduling note (snow removal if applicable)
avoid: bullet lists without any photo proof
interaction_kit: hero with slow ken-burns style zoom on a real project photo
before/after drag slider in the gallery section (mouse and touch)
scroll-reveal masonry images with 80ms stagger
seasonal band fades between color themes based on current month

must_include: storm and hail damage handling if serving affected region
interaction_kit: parallax sky background on the hero
subtle rain or particle overlay on the storm-damage band (disabled on mobile)
count-up numbers on trust badges (years in business, roofs replaced)
pulsing 'Free Inspection' CTA shadow

dentist.tone: calm, clean, reassuring; modern medical without feeling sterile
avoid: overly clinical stock photos of generic teeth
interaction_kit: soft fade-in hero with minimal motion (no pulses, no bounces)
scroll-reveal on team cards with gentle 300ms ease
booking CTA has a quiet resting glow; hover deepens shadow
insurance pills fade in one-by-one, 60ms stagger
hero gradient shifts warmer or cooler based on current season
emergency call CTA pulses gently
scroll-reveal on seasonal band columns with directional slide
count-up on 'response time' metrics if scraped

must_include: core services (panel, wiring, EV charger, lighting)
avoid: lightning bolt clip art as primary hero visual
interaction_kit: accent-yellow glow under primary CTA on hover (safety-panel feel)
icon fill-on-hover for service cards (stroke to fill transition)
scroll-reveal stagger on service grid
subtle grid-line background animation on hero (very slow drift)
slow breathe animation on hero headline (opacity 1 to 0.85 to 1, 4s loop)
scroll-reveal with long ease-out (500ms) on condition cards
calm parallax on hero background
no aggressive pulses or bounces anywhere
hero photo with slow ken-burns zoom (1.0 to 1.05 over 18s)
menu tabs with cross-fade between categories (200ms)
scroll-reveal menu items with 50ms stagger
sticky 'Reserve' button bottom-right after 40vh scroll

restaurant-upscale.tone: editorial, quiet confidence, sense of occasion; fewer words, more silence around them
must_include: chef or owner backstory if scraped
seasonal or tasting menu reference if scraped
reservations-first mentality (primary CTA is reserve, not order)
dress code or atmosphere cue if scraped
interaction_kit: very slow fade-in reveals (700ms ease) with 250ms stagger
minimal hover motion: underline grow, no card lifts
hero with gentle parallax only (0.1x scroll)
respect white space over motion; restraint is the aesthetic

cafe-bakery.tone: warm, handmade, neighborhood-rooted; voice like a handwritten note
must_include: daily baked or made-today line if scraped
hours visible — breakfast crowd depends on it
menu with category tabs (coffee, pastry, lunch)
whether they serve whole cakes / pre-order if scraped
interaction_kit: hand-drawn underline reveal on nav hover (SVG stroke-dashoffset)
scroll-reveal menu items with warm easing (400ms cubic)
hero photo gentle parallax
hours band with 'open now' dot pulsing if currently open

must_include: service price list or 'starting at' pricing
photo gallery of real work (not stock)
product lines carried if scraped (Redken, Oribe, etc.)
interaction_kit: editorial image reveals (vertical mask wipe 600ms)
scroll-reveal on stylist cards with left accent-border drawing in
services price menu rows: accent fill behind row on hover
hero photo scale-in on load (1.04 to 1.0 over 800ms)

barber.tone: craft-first, understated masculinity, shop-culture — not 'bro energy'
must_include: service price list (cut, beard, shave, hot towel)
barber bios with years in craft
shop history or founding year if scraped
avoid: fake vintage sepia overlays on everything
interaction_kit: scroll-reveal with diagonal clip-path masks (sharp, shop-floor feel)
hover underline with thick accent stroke on service links
hero with subtle grain texture overlay (CSS filter)
price rows: name goes accent-red on hover
editorial fade+slide reveals (15-20px travel, 500ms ease) on every section
before/after slider in gallery (drag or arrow controls)
subtle scroll-linked blur-to-sharp on hero image
luxurious hover on service cards: minimal shift, accent border glow

fitness-gym.tone: high-energy but not yelling; disciplined, community-driven
must_include: first-week free / trial offer if scraped
interaction_kit: count-up stats on scroll (members, classes per week, years open)
hero video or image with scroll-linked zoom (1.0 to 1.1 over viewport)
class cards with kinetic hover: left accent border grows 0 to 4px, 2px shift right
marquee ticker of class types at the bottom of hero

yoga-studio.tone: calm, grounded, breath-forward; soft but not saccharine
must_include: intro offer (first class free / $X for 2 weeks)
avoid: new-age clip art (lotus flowers, chakras) as primary visual
stock photos of perfect poses on cliffsides
interaction_kit: slow breathe ambient pulse on hero (opacity and scale, 6s loop)
scroll-reveal with long 600ms ease on every section
no count-ups, no marquees, no fast motion anywhere
instructor portraits fade in one at a time, 300ms stagger

law-firm.tone: authoritative, measured, plain-language; serious without being cold
must_include: attorney bios with bar admissions and years practicing
clear consultation CTA with 'free consultation' only if scraped
case results or settlements only with 'past results do not guarantee' disclaimer
avoid: gavel and scales-of-justice clip art in hero
interaction_kit: measured fade-in (400ms, no slide) on every section
stagger slow (150ms) on practice-area cards
count-up on case results strip (years practicing, cases won, dollars recovered)
no bouncy spring motion; authority means restraint

auto-repair.tone: capable, no-nonsense, shop-floor voice; honesty as a differentiator
must_include: service categories matched to scraped work
ASE / AAA / manufacturer certifications if scraped
warranty statement if scraped (e.g., '24 months / 24k miles')
avoid: vague 'we fix cars' copy without service specifics
interaction_kit: icon fill-on-hover for vehicle service cards (outline to solid)
scroll-reveal with industrial 350ms cubic-bezier
accent-orange left border grows on service card hover
trust-badge row slides in from right on scroll

general-contractor.tone: builder's voice — craft, precision, on-budget delivery; not marketing polish
must_include: project types (remodel, addition, new build, commercial)
portfolio / completed projects with real photos
avoid: clip-art hard hats or blueprints as primary visual
interaction_kit: portfolio cards with scroll-reveal and 120ms stagger
before/after drag slider on featured project
hover on project card: deep shadow grows, subtle rotate 0.5deg
count-up on years in business or projects completed
